create_schema: Copy the column definitions from the docstring exactly, including the CHECK constraints.
add_task: conn.execute('INSERT INTO tasks (title) VALUES (?)', (title,)) inside `with conn:`; return cursor.lastrowid.
list_tasks: Add a WHERE clause only when done is not None.
Convert the done column with bool(); ORDER BY id.
transfer: Both updates must succeed or neither.
Do both UPDATEs inside `with conn:`; catch sqlite3.IntegrityError and raise ValueError; check rowcount for unknown accounts.
count_by_status: Start with {'open': 0, 'done': 0} and fill it from SELECT done, COUNT(*) ... GROUP BY done.
build_request: Set method='GET', Accept and User-Agent exactly as the docstring says.
fetch_json: Use the injected opener, not the network.
with opener(request, timeout=timeout) as r: body = r.read(); json.loads in try/except.
collect_pages: Keep following 'next' until it is None.
Count pages and raise RuntimeError past max_pages.
search_tasks: LIKE with % wildcards; SQLite LIKE ignores ASCII case.
set_setting: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value.
build_url: Strip slashes at the join point.
base.rstrip('/') + '/' + path.lstrip('/'); add '?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(params) when params.
paginate: Pages start at 1, so page 1 starts at index 0.
start = (page - 1) * per_page; pages = ceil(len / per_page), e.g. -(-len(items) // per_page).
